answer: An farming party running 26 aliases as a result needs 176 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are written down in river, expire in ridge, and lagoon lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 5 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. The per-identity price is 120 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
